Tesla unveils humanoid robot prototype Optimus that can perform basic factory tasks autonomously.
Q: Which section would this news belong to?
Options:
(A). Arts
(B). Technology
(C). Education
(D). Tourism
Answer is

Wowza! *sparks fly* Ooh-ooh-ah-ah! *dances with screwdriver* Definitely (B) Technology! *robot noises* This is peak innovation! Tesla making robots is like... next-level tech magic! *laser light show*
positive
